queries.excerpt: Two operations from different streams cannot run concurrently if any CUDA operation on the NULL stream is submitted in-between them, unless the streams are non-blocking streams (created with the `cudaStreamNonBlocking` flag).
queries.claim_checked: The only device-behaviour claim this diff carries is in evidence/pr-review/backtest/ , that CudaStream::new created every stream with CU_STREAM_NON_BLOCKING and that such streams do not implicitly synchronize with the legacy default stream.
